description: SLICE CAVE v2 (chained). Fixes two proven defects in v1: (a) WRAP BUG - az_s is normalised to (-180,180] but the body facing is raw, so straddling kicks computed a -358deg delta and produced a full-strength wrong-way curl; now wrapped properly. (b) MAGNITUDE - K_SIDE 0.05 gave only 5-13cm of lateral drift (invisible); now clamped to +/-15deg and scaled by K=0.5, giving ~2m of curl over a 1.2s flight. Adds ONLY to omega.y, which by the cross-product geometry produces pure horizontal force and CANNOT lift the ball. Part A @0x14105ed20 (delta+wrap) chains to part B @0x1438b4835 (clamp+scale+apply).

patches.name: slice cave v2 part A (delta + wrap)
slice cave v2 part B (clamp + K=0.5 + apply)
